name: Update Unit Type

pathParams.name: unitTypeId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the unit type to update.

requestBody.description: Attributes to update on the unit type.

attributes.name: ApplicationFee
attributes.description: The fee charged when applying for a unit of this type. If the property associated with the unit type is payments enabled (if the property's bank account is payment enabled), then the ApplicationFee must be $0.00 or between $6 and $200.

attributes.name: Amenities
attributes.description: The amenities associated with the unit type. Amenity names are case-sensitive. Providing an array of valid strings will overwrite all existing amenities. Passing in an empty array [] or an array of empty strings [""] or ["", ""] will clear all existing amenities. Passing in an array of a valid string and an empty string ["amenity_name", ""] will result in Amenities: ["amenity_name"]. Passing in null will result in no change.

attributes.name: Bathrooms
attributes.description: The number of bathrooms for this unit type.

attributes.name: Bedrooms
attributes.description: The number of bedrooms for this unit type.

attributes.name: CatsAllowed
attributes.description: The unit type's cat policy. Valid values include "Yes", "No" or null. A null value indicates that the unit type may not have specified a policy for cats.

attributes.name: FutureMarketRent
attributes.description: The projected future market rent for the unit type. This attribute must be provided together with FutureMarketRentEffectiveOn date. Both attributes must either be present or absent together.

attributes.name: FutureMarketRentEffectiveOn
attributes.description: The date when the FutureMarketRent will take effect. This attribute must be provided together with FutureMarketRent. Both attributes must either be present or absent together.

attributes.name: MarketRent
attributes.description: The current market rent for the unit type.

attributes.name: MarketingTitle
attributes.description: The title of the listing for syndication.

attributes.name: MarketingDescription
attributes.description: A description of the listing for syndication.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the unit type. This value must be unique per PropertyId, meaning different unit types can use the same Name only when their PropertyIds are different.

attributes.name: SquareFeet
attributes.description: The size of the unit type in square feet.

attributes.name: YouTubeURL
attributes.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing(s).

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated unit type.

requestSample:
{
  "Name": "Unit Type A",
  "Amenities": [
    "gym",
    "covered parking"
  ],
  "ApplicationFee": 20.23,
  "Bathrooms": 2.5,
  "Bedrooms": 3,
  "CatsAllowed": "Yes",
  "Deposit": 300.34,
  "DogsAllowed": "Large & Small",
  "MarketRent": 1569.05,
  "FutureMarketRent": 699.99,
  "FutureMarketRentEffectiveOn": "2022-02-08",
  "MarketingDescription": "Sample marketing description",
  "MarketingTitle": "Sample marketing title",
  "SquareFeet": 2000,
  "YouTubeURL": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc"
}
